items.title: George Wein interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: I put the band together. ... I had Jimmy McPartland playing the trumpet for the Sal Mineo before he got the magic horn

ctx.x: I must have been reading the music or something. It doesn’t sound like me. There’s a funny story about that. We had this story, “The Magic Horn” was the story of a trumpet player and I guess Sal Mineo was the young guy, and Ralph Meeker. It was a television show. And I was the musical director. I put the band together. And — God I haven’t heard that in ages — I wouldn’t have guessed that — I knew it was Ruby, because nobody plays like Ruby. And so the story was the trumpet player who plays Sal Mineo was just an…
